summary.text: Raelyn Light is the Green Party candidate for Michigan's 13th District, advancing from the party's July 18, 2026 convention. Little biographical information is available in public sources.

paragraphs.text: Advanced from the Green Party convention on July 18, 2026 and is on the November 3, 2026 general-election ballot.
